epDuplicateName.description: EP — already-exists partition: a name that resolves to a pre-existing type. The backend returns 400 Container type already exists and the FE surfaces it via toast.error().

epUniqueName.description: EP — new unique name partition: a disposable name that has never been used. Resolves 201 and the new row appears in the modal list.

deleteContainer.description: One unit loaded into the container via POST /containers/:id/quantities so cur_items > 0, which disables the Delete icon button.
